name: Egerszalók (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner charged near the top with the municipal arms of Egerszalók: a blue shield with a yellow lion, with a helm and green, blue and yellow mantling, above a scroll inscribed EGERSZALÓK.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Egerszalók arms with helm, mantling and scroll
